in_sanskrit.name: निवाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: निवासनम् शान्तिः (Nivāsanam Shāntiḥ) - The peaceful abode of one's self

in_marathi.name: Nivash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Aborigine's dwelling, residence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nivash refers to the abode, dwelling, or residence of a deity or an aborigine. The name signifies the idea of a sacred and protected space, evoking feelings of peace, stability, and security.
